The '''Victor-wing Fighter''' was a model of [[starfighter]]<ref name="Kids" /> that was active during the [[Imperial Era]] and used by criminal factions.<ref name="Outlaws" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Vader Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Vader Immortal: A Star Wars VR Series – Episode I'' to [[1 BBY]].</ref> several Victor-wing fighters ambushed the [[Smuggler|smuggling ship]] ''[[Windfall]]'' after the [[freighter]] stole a shipment of [[spice]] from the [[Hutt Clan]].<ref name="Vader Immortal I">{{VaderImmortal|I}}</ref> By [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Outlaws Date">{{OutlawsDate}}</ref> Victor-wing Fighters were used by [[Crimson Dawn]] in the [[Realspace|space]] around both the [[moon]] [[Toshara]] and the [[planet]] [[Kijimi]]. These Victor-wings used the [[Color|red]] livery associated with the Dawn.<ref name="Outlaws" />

A bunch of Victor-wing Fighters were part of the [[Citizens' Fleet]] that fought at the [[Battle of Exegol]]<ref name="Episode IX" /> in [[35 ABY]],<ref name="TROS Date">{{StoryCite|story=A Eulogy for Snap|book=Star Wars (2020) 25|bformatted=''Star Wars'' (2020) 25}}</ref> assisting [[Resistance]] forces in their fight against the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]].<ref name="Episode IX" /> Victor-wing Fighters were equipped with eight small [[sublight engine]]s and a [[hyperdrive]] system,<ref name="Episode IX" /> and were armed with four frontal [[laser cannon]]s and a dorsal quad [[ion cannon]] [[turret]].<ref name="Outlaws" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Victor-wing-Fighter-Concept.jpg|thumb|left|275px|Victor-wing Fighter concept art]]
It was initially designed for [[2015]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] as the ship used by the criminal organization [[Kanjiklub]],<ref name="Clyne Instagram">{{Instagram|username=clyne_design|url=p/CD7IExND4aj|name=[[James Clyne]]|quote=Background ship we reused for #theriseofskywalker Initially designed for #theforceawakens for he Kanjiklub's ship. Also-some major kitbashing due to crazy time constraints… and just too fun not to.|archiveurl=https://archive.vn/cs6Mn}}</ref> but it did not appear in the final film.<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref> Due to time constraints at the time, the ship's design was created by kit-bashing other ships together.<ref name="Clyne Instagram" /> The fighter eventually appeared for the first time in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> The ship was later identified in the video "Every Ship in the Star Wars Sequel Trilogy," posted on the [[StarWarsKids.com]] [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] channel in [[2020]].<ref name="Kids" />

The ship was initially referred to as a V-wing, which shouldn't be confused for the [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter|V-wings]] that appeared in the prequels; however, as several models of the same name already existed, it was later renamed after [[Victor Starspeeder]], a character created by [[Jarrett J. Krosoczka]] for the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Academy]]'' novel series.<ref name="Twitter Leland">{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/1289450476732203009|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=Production was referring to it as a V-wing but since we already had a couple of V-wings, we went with Victor-wing fighter, a name @studiojjk came up with for his @Scholastic Jedi Academy books. #VictorStarspeeder|archiveurl=https://archive.is/CpbYX}}</ref>
